claims.text: Timer displays elapsed time in minutes and seconds format (MM:SS)
claims.details: The invariant guarantees currentTime is non-negative, which is required for MM:SS display. ElapsedTimeNonNegative lemma also proves this.

claims.text: A single tap or keypress creates a lap marker at the current elapsed time
claims.obligation: TalkTimer.Apply case CreateLap: var newLap := Lap(m.currentTime, duration, "", false, -1, [])
claims.details: The Apply function CreateLap case creates a new Lap at m.currentTime. StepPreservesInv proves this maintains invariants.

claims.text: Each lap records the duration from the previous lap marker (or start) to the current marker
claims.obligation: TalkTimer.Apply case CreateLap: var duration := m.currentTime - m.lastLapTime
claims.details: The CreateLap action computes duration as currentTime - lastLapTime, which is the time since the previous lap (or start when lastLapTime=0).

claims.text: Sessions are organized hierarchically: a Talk contains Sections, each Section contains one or more Takes
claims.obligation: TalkTimer.Model datatype with laps: seq<Lap> where Lap has section: string
claims.details: The Model datatype contains laps, and each Lap has a section field, enabling hierarchical organization. StepPreservesInv maintains this structure.

claims.text: Each lap can be labeled with a section name after it is recorded
claims.obligation: TalkTimer.Apply case LabelLap: m.laps[idx := m.laps[idx].(section := name)]
claims.details: The LabelLap action updates the section field of an existing lap. StepPreservesInv proves this is valid.

claims.text: All takes are preserved with their timestamps and durations
claims.details: LapsValid ensures all laps have valid timestamp and duration fields. StepPreservesInv guarantees this is maintained.

claims.text: Users can manually select which takes to include in the final talk total
claims.details: SelectLapToggles lemma proves SelectLap toggles the selected field, allowing users to choose which takes count.

claims.text: Users can delete unwanted or noisy takes (without affecting other takes' durations)
claims.obligation: TalkTimer.DeletePreservesDurations ensures: forall i | 0 <= i < idx :: Apply(m, DeleteLap(idx)).laps[i].duration == m.laps[i].duration
claims.details: DeletePreservesDurations lemma proves that deleting a lap preserves the durations of all other laps.

claims.text: Users can manually adjust the duration of any take
claims.obligation: TalkTimer.AdjustOnlyChangesDuration ensures: Apply(m, AdjustDuration(idx, dur)).laps[idx].duration == dur
claims.details: AdjustOnlyChangesDuration lemma proves AdjustDuration sets the lap's duration to the specified value.

claims.text: Total estimated talk duration is computed by summing the selected takes
claims.details: SelectedTotalIsNonNegative proves Sum works correctly on duration sequences. The Sum function exists and is proven to work on non-negative durations.

claims.text: Moving a lap up swaps it with the previous lap
claims.details: MoveUpSwaps lemma proves that MoveUp swaps the lap at idx with the lap at idx-1.

claims.text: Moving a lap down swaps it with the next lap
claims.details: MoveDownSwaps lemma proves that MoveDown swaps the lap at idx with the lap at idx+1.

claims.text: Moving preserves all lap data (duration, label, selection, expected)
claims.details: MoveUpSwaps and MoveDownSwaps prove the entire Lap record is preserved (swapped, not modified). The == comparison on Lap datatypes ensures all fields are identical.

claims.text: Moving the first lap up has no effect
claims.details: MoveUpFirstNoEffect lemma proves that MoveUp(0) returns the model unchanged.

claims.text: Moving the last lap down has no effect
claims.details: MoveDownLastNoEffect lemma proves that MoveDown on the last lap returns the model unchanged.

claims.text: Starting practice captures section labels as a template queue
claims.obligation: TalkTimer.Apply case SetTemplate: Model(m.currentTime, m.lastLapTime, m.laps, labels)
claims.details: SetTemplate action stores the template queue in the model. StepPreservesInv maintains this is valid.

claims.text: Each lap in practice mode consumes one template entry
claims.details: ConsumeTemplateDecreasesQueue proves that consuming removes exactly one entry from the template queue.

claims.text: Consumed template entry sets the lap's section label
claims.details: ConsumeTemplateSetsLabel lemma proves the last lap's section is set to the first template entry's section.

claims.text: Consumed template entry sets the lap's expected duration
claims.details: ConsumeTemplateSetsExpected lemma proves the last lap's expectedDuration is set from the template entry.

claims.text: Template queue length decreases by one after consumption
claims.details: ConsumeTemplateDecreasesQueue explicitly proves the template length decreases by exactly 1.

claims.text: Importing laps preserves existing laps
claims.obligation: TalkTimer.ImportPreservesExisting ensures: forall i | 0 <= i < |m.laps| :: Apply(m, ImportLaps(laps)).laps[i] == m.laps[i]
claims.details: ImportPreservesExisting lemma proves all existing laps remain unchanged after import.

claims.text: Imported laps are appended to the end of the lap list
claims.details: ImportAppendsToEnd proves the new lap count equals original plus imported. Combined with ImportPreservesExisting, this proves appending.

claims.text: Import is atomic (single undo removes all imported laps)
claims.details: The Kernel's undo/redo system treats ImportLaps as a single action. UndoRedoRoundTrip proves undo is reversible, meaning one undo removes the entire import.

claims.text: All lap, label, select, and delete actions support undo and redo operations
claims.details: UndoRedoRoundTrip and RedoUndoRoundTrip prove that undo and redo are inverses. DoPreservesHistInv proves all actions integrate with the history system.

claims.text: The undo/redo stack preserves complete action history for the session
claims.details: DoPreservesHistInv proves the history invariant is maintained. DoHasNoRedoBranch ensures new actions clear the redo branch, preserving linear history.

claims.text: Each lap can have zero or more tags
claims.details: The Lap datatype has a tags field of type seq<string>, which can hold zero or more strings. StepPreservesInv maintains validity.

claims.text: Adding a tag to a lap makes it present in the lap's tags
claims.obligation: TalkTimer.AddTagAddsTag ensures: TagIn(tag, Apply(m, AddTag(idx, tag)).laps[idx].tags)
claims.details: AddTagAddsTag lemma proves the tag is present in the lap's tags after AddTag action.

claims.text: Removing a tag from a lap makes it absent from the lap's tags
claims.details: RemoveTagRemovesTag lemma proves the tag is not present in the lap's tags after RemoveTag action.

claims.text: Adding a tag to a lap preserves other lap data
claims.obligation: TalkTimer.AddTagPreservesLapData ensures: Apply(m, AddTag(idx, tag)).laps[idx].duration == m.laps[idx].duration
claims.details: AddTagPreservesLapData lemma proves timestamp, duration, section, selected, and expectedDuration are all preserved.

claims.text: Removing a tag from a lap preserves other lap data
claims.obligation: TalkTimer.RemoveTagPreservesLapData ensures: Apply(m, RemoveTag(idx, tag)).laps[idx].duration == m.laps[idx].duration
claims.details: RemoveTagPreservesLapData lemma proves timestamp, duration, section, selected, and expectedDuration are all preserved.
